title: DATESBETWEEN includes both boundaries
query: EVALUATE VAR R = DATESBETWEEN ( 'Date'[Date], DATE ( 2024, 1, 31 ), DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) )

source.quote: The dates used as StartDate and EndDate are inclusive.
source.supports: both ends are in the result

derivation: January 31 to February 10, 2024, both included: 1 + 10 = 11 days. Sales: Jan 31 200 + Feb 10 300 = 500.
